title: Draft: QTBUG-106718 workarounds
description:
This was purposefully extracted away from !13509. There are two ways to solve #18875 for broken Qt versions:
- QueuedConnection workaround, or
- Removing nested event loops inside signal handlers (i.e. removing all exec() and QCoreApplication::processEvents() calls)

Because QTBUG-106718 is really fixed in newer Qt versions, doing the workarounds might be considered harmful. The nested event loops removal is actually beneficial, because there are multiple types of issues that are caused by nested event loops.

---

Qt: Workaround crash on manage profile via status bar menu

Connect manageProfile() slots with Qt::QueuedConnection to workaround crash due to QTBUG-106718. Use lambda functions to call manageProfile() with correct parameter instead of setting action property because the sender action is already deleted before the slot gets called when connected with Qt::QueuedConnection.
